name: Gradle
description: The inspected Gradle wrapper supports SHA-256 checking through distributionSha256Sum configuration. This supports a configurable integrity control, not a complete publisher-authentication classification for all generated wrappers.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical Gradle wrapper revision under study.
